faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Tractor Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the application for the PAU Tractor Operator recruitment is 21-08-2026. Ensure your application reaches the authorities before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the eligibility criteria for the Tractor Operator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed Matric with Punjabi and possess a Valid Tractor Driving License with one year of experience, or Middle with Punjabi and a Valid Tractor Driving License with two years of experience in running and maintenance of tractors and agricultural implements.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Tractor Operator position?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 50 years for the Tractor Operator post. Age relaxation will be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Tractor Operator job at PAU?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the specified address before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the PAU Tractor Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 100/- for General/OBC and SC/ST categories. This fee needs to be submitted along with the application form.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Tractor Operator role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Tractor Operator position will involve a Driving Test and Document Verification. Candidates must perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any experience required for the Tractor Operator post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates need to have either one year of experience in running and maintenance of tractors and agricultural implements (if applying with Matriculation) or two years of experience (if applying with Middle school education).

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Punjab Agricultural University (PAU), the link for which is provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Tractor Operator post at PAU is Full Time.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Punjab Agricultural University?
faq.answer: The official website of Punjab Agricultural University is https://www.pau.edu. You can visit this site for more information and to download application forms.
